families.primary: 64 planned M4-minus-other scenario contrasts; Holm including unavailable hypotheses as untested p=1 placeholders
families.secondary: 64 planned exposure/time contrasts; same Holm convention

binaryTest: paired exact McNemar via binomial discordance; independent Fisher sensitivity only if pairing not verified
continuousTest: paired t and dz among joint completers for conditional duration; independent Welch/Hedges sensitivity when unpaired
confidence: 95% t intervals for continuous mean differences; paired block bootstrap for binary risk differences and effect-size uncertainty; no field-population generalization
factorial: sum-coded Method*Scenario; attempt mixed random intercept Block on complete continuous design; report singularity/convergence, then cluster-robust OLS fallback; linear-probability factorial for binary endpoints
weightSampling: mission share U(.1,.9); split remaining safety share U(.1,.9) between minimum-clearance utility and exposure fraction

utility.MissionUtility: 0 for non-success; otherwise max(0,1-Duration/180); decision utility, never an imputed measured time
utility.SafetyUtility: clip((minimum ground-truth XZ distance-.45)/(.1*12-.45),0,1) per run before aggregation
utility.PersonalExposureFraction: observed exposure below1.2 / (known RUN-END duration minus missing-ground-truth exposure time); known absence of humans remains in denominator

missing: no imputation; retain failure outcomes; endpoint n and nonestimable cells explicit; no incomplete-cell factorial contrast extrapolation
benchmark: instrumented in-campaign controller traces E1/E4, all 9 methods, all attempts; p50/p95/p99 and deadline misses at common fixed period; separate observer overhead; CPU from owned process sampler
